claims.text: Figure 2 presents an overview of the Edcraft Gamified Learning (EGL) activity flow, which is part of the conceptual framework related to recycling intention.
The EGL activity flow in Figure 2 is linked to the thematic analysis results, which emphasize social influence and gamification in enhancing recycling intention among youths.
The conceptual model in Figure 2 is derived from the thematic analysis that identifies key themes influencing recycling behavior, including social influence and gamification elements.
